title: Memory
description: A memory. Class-level properties describe the memory type/category. Instance-level properties describe a concrete agent memory record (observation, belief, or event) retained at a specific time.

id.description: [instance-level] Stable identifier for this memory record.

run_id.description: [instance-level] Identifier of the run this memory belongs to.

agent_id.description: [instance-level] Identifier of the agent that holds this memory.

timestamp_s.description: [instance-level] Simulated time in seconds when the memory was formed/recorded.

version.description: [class-level] Schema version of the memory record format.

source_record_id.description: [instance-level] Identifier of the source record this memory references (observation, belief, or event id).

source_record_type.description: [class-level] Type of the source record referenced by this memory.

last_accessed_s.description: [instance-level] Simulated time when the memory was last accessed, if any.

retention_priority.description: [instance-level] Priority for retention vs. forgetting (0 to 1).

examples.content_summary: Believes coconuts move when touched, confidence 0.8.
